warnings: Nfurcation trajectory splines have zero-radius placeholders. Positions use the native trajectory; radii use its corresponding native shape spline at the nearest projected centerline position. The inlet uses shape spline 0; each outlet uses its own shape spline. A shared junction has one representative radius from inlet shape 0, without averaging. SWC cannot encode the complete noncircular bifurcation; the native VTK surface is authoritative.
Input parent direction is treated as flow direction; SWC alone cannot confirm measured physiological flow.
vascularmd.units: XYZ and radius in mm; original numerical units preserved; no scaling

native_model_call.note: criterion chooses native smoothing lambdas; akaike controls a different control-point-count selection option

comparison.pair_exclusion: Pairs touching a bifurcation node excluded; no threshold-based filtering
comparison.sampling_caveat: Jump magnitude depends on sampling density; original-count preserves each mapped source-path count. Native merges can change total count by duplicating short shared source trunks. Spacing mode changes density.
comparison.raw_baseline: Original topology branches counted once, including when native merging duplicates a source trunk across mapped paths

type_mapping.policy: original junction/end types; internal type from nearest original normalized arc position inside the same branch

surface.post_filter: none added; native Nfurcation mesh relaxation/projection is retained
